description: This Java interface defines the AuthorizationSubject entity in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing an entity subject to authorization, such as a user. It includes a static factory method for creation and a method to retrieve the subject's identifier.

classes.name: AuthorizationSubject
classes.description: An immutable interface representing an entity subject of authorization in the Ditto system, such as a user.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: A static factory method that creates a new immutable AuthorizationSubject with a specified identifier.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the authorization subject.
